author: DevTemWPF
name: DevTemWPF Service Unit Test
description: Adds a behavioral unit test scaffold that exercises service methods following project conventions. Use the same name as the service plus a Tests suffix (e.g. -n SyncServiceTests).

RootNamespace.description: Root namespace of the generated app (the .App and .Unit suffixes are preserved).

TargetServiceName.description: Service type under test, derived from the item name minus the Tests suffix.
